# Free AI Credits

> Every currently-claimable free AI credit offer, labeled with review status, evidence level, and sign-up need, on one fast page. Curated from official provider sources and refreshed at build time.

## Trust labels

Two independent labels qualify every offer: review status says how far the curator has reviewed the listing; evidence level says what the offer's terms rest on. Neither one means the curator completed the claim, and the last-checked date is when the entry was last confirmed against its source.

In one line: corroborated = evidence level · reviewed / tested = review status · checked = the last-checked date.

**Review status** (`review_status`) — How far has the curator reviewed this listing?

- `review_status=verified` — reviewed: The curator has read this listing against the provider's own source and its terms match what is listed. No claim attempt is attested by this value.
- `review_status=under-review` — under review: The curator is testing this listing now. A claim attempt is in progress; its outcome is not recorded yet.
- `review_status=unverified` — not reviewed: The curator has not reviewed this listing firsthand yet. No claim attempt is attested.
- `review_status=to-be-verified` — to be verified: The listing's current details need follow-up verification before they can be relied on. No claim attempt is attested.

**Evidence level** (`verification`) — What do this offer's terms rest on?

- `verification=social_proof` — corroborated: The offer's terms are corroborated by the provider's own site plus at least one social or community source. This axis records corroboration only — whether a claim was attempted is the review status.
- `verification=unverified` — early (unconfirmed): Public posts describe this early offer, but its terms are not yet on the provider's own site, so treat every term as unconfirmed. This axis records corroboration only — whether a claim was attempted is the review status.

**Sign-up need** (`signup`) — Does claiming need an account?

- `signup=none` — no sign-up: Claimable without creating an account.
- `signup=required` — sign-up required: Claiming needs a (free) account.

**Last checked** (`last_checked`) — The date the curator last confirmed the entry against its source. It describes the listing's freshness, not the offer's expiry. An offer's expiry date is its enrollment deadline — the last date to claim — not how long the credits stay valid. When a provider states how long claimed credits last, that term is in the amount text.

- [About](https://freetokens.custats.info/about.html): What the site is, how listings are reviewed and checked, and what the numbers mean.
- [Privacy Policy](https://freetokens.custats.info/privacy.html): How the site handles data — consent-gated anonymized analytics, no forms, no personal data storage.
- [Full export](https://freetokens.custats.info/llms-full.txt): the long-form companion to this file — every active offer with its summary, claim steps, source and detail links and the same trust fields, plus the build date and any truncation.
